run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-18T00:46:24Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for otel-demo/frontend-proxy coincides with a step change in frontend-proxy error spans at about 2026-11-18T00:46:24Z, and the sampled traces show the failure is on the checkout path: frontend-proxy ingress and 'router frontend egress' return HTTP 500, propagating from frontend POST /api/checkout -> frontend grpc CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (grpc 13) -> checkout PlaceOrder -> shipping /get-quote, whose own client span 'POST quote' ends as 'Timeout' after 5,001,645 us. Facts: chaos-mesh events show a Schedule named otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition (namespace chaos-mesh) spawning NetworkChaos objects every minute from 00:46:18Z, and each NetworkChaos reports 'Successfully apply chaos' to otel-demo/shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv and otel-demo/quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w, 'Time up according to the duration' ~55s later, then recovery. Corroborating facts: the quote container logged 'Calculated quote' continuously until 00:46:16Z and afterwards only in ~5-second bursts at ~:13 of each minute (the gaps between experiments), the shipping container logged 'Sending Quote' only in those same gaps, and quote's span volume fell from ~352.6/10m to ~38.6/10m with no error status of its own. Hypothesis (not proven): that recurring network partition blackholed shipping->quote traffic, producing the 5s timeouts, shipping 500s and the upstream 500s that drove the frontend-proxy error rate; the NetworkChaos/Schedule specs could not be read, so the declared action, direction, target selectors and duration remain unverified, and the wrapped error text naming the 'email service' could not be reconciled with shipping's own 'POST quote' timeout span. Also observed and cleaned out as causes: no pod restarts/last-state terminations, all otel-demo pods Running/Ready, all flagd fault flags off, and quote/shipping Endpoints present.

claims.text: frontend-proxy error spans rose sharply after 00:46:24Z: 10-minute increases for span_name=ingress with status_code=STATUS_CODE_ERROR were 2.27, 5.28, 7.37, 9.47, 8.42 for the successive windows ending 23:56:24-00:46:24Z, then 142.11 (00:51:24Z), 295.79 (00:56:24Z) and 233.63 (01:01:24Z); span_name='router frontend egress' with STATUS_CODE_ERROR follows the same pattern (0 before, then 137.89, 292.63, 228.27).

At 5-minute resolution the frontend-proxy 'ingress' error-span increase was 3.33-5.56 per 5 minutes through the point at 00:46:00Z, then 13.33 at 00:47:00Z, 43.33 at 00:48:00Z, 80.0 at 00:49:00Z, 115.56 at 00:50:00Z, 146.67 at 00:51:00Z and 175.56 at 00:52:00Z, i.e. the deviation begins immediately after 00:46Z.

In trace 925ee26147ff69ef34318fad699a2701 the error chain is: load-generator POST 500 -> frontend-proxy ingress (http.status_code=500, error) -> frontend-proxy 'router frontend egress' (500) -> frontend POST /api/checkout (500) -> frontend grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (rpc.grpc.status_code=13) -> checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (error, status_description 'shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500') -> checkout span 'HTTP POST' (error) -> shipping span '/get-quote' (error, status_description 'Internal Server Error') -> shipping client span 'POST quote' (error, status_description 'Timeout', duration_us 5001645).

The error spans are confined to the checkout path: 10-minute increases first appear in the window ending 00:51:24Z for shipping '/get-quote' and 'POST quote' (134.75, 290.53, 228.27), checkout 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' and 'HTTP POST' (133.91, 290.53, 228.83), and frontend 'POST /api/checkout' and 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' (136.84, 290.53, 228.27), while frontend 'GET /api/cart', 'GET /api/data', 'grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart', 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' and 'grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem' error series stayed at 0 across the same points.

A chaos-mesh Schedule named otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition (namespace chaos-mesh) emitted 'Create new object: otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition-<suffix>' Spawned events at 00:46:18Z, 00:47:18Z, 00:48:18Z, 00:49:18Z, 00:50:18Z, 00:51:18Z, 00:52:18Z, 00:53:18Z, 00:54:18Z and 00:55:18Z, each followed by 'Successfully update lastScheduleTime of resource'.

Those NetworkChaos objects report 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv' and 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w' (e.g. at 00:46:18Z), followed ~55s later by 'Time up according to the duration' and 'Successfully recover chaos' for both pods (00:47:13Z), repeating each minute through 00:55:18Z; matching PodNetworkChaos 'Updated' events were recorded for the shipping and quote pods in namespace otel-demo.

The quote container logged 'Calculated quote' continuously up to 00:46:16.394Z and afterwards only in short bursts at 00:47:13-00:47:17, 00:48:13-00:48:16, 00:49:13, 00:50:13-00:50:16, 00:51:13-00:51:17, 00:52:13-00:52:15, 00:53:13-00:53:18, 00:54:13-00:54:14, 00:55:13-00:55:14 and 00:56:13 — windows that fall in the ~5-second gaps between successive chaos experiments.

The shipping container logged 'Requesting quote' repeatedly through 00:54:49-00:56:23Z but logged 'Sending Quote' only at 00:55:13.235-00:55:14.107Z and 00:56:13.244-00:56:13.947Z, i.e. only in the gaps between consecutive chaos experiments.

Quote's own span volume fell while carrying no error status: 10-minute increases for span_name 'POST /getquote' were 352.63 (00:46:24Z), 214.74 (00:51:24Z), 58.95 (00:56:24Z) and 38.58 (01:01:24Z), 'calculate-quote' and '{closure}' follow the same values, and all quote series carry status_code=STATUS_CODE_UNSET only.

Email span volume fell in the same way without error status: 10-minute increases for 'POST /send_order_confirmation' and 'send_email' were 355.79 at 00:46:24Z and 58.95 at 00:56:24Z, and 'sinatra.render_template' went 711.58 -> 117.89; a window-wide query of STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans summed by service_name returned series only for accounting, ad, checkout, frontend, frontend-proxy, payment, recommendation and shipping — no email series was returned.

All 21 otel-demo pods were Running with all containers ready and restartCount 0, including frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-wvxht, shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv and quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w, whose containers have an empty lastState (no termination/OOM record).

The otel-demo ConfigMap flagd-config key demo.flagd.json holds 13 flags (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure) all with state ENABLED and defaultVariant 'off' (false/0), i.e. no fault flag is switched on.
Endpoints exist for quote (100.96.1.165, port 8080) and shipping (100.96.1.109, port 8080) in namespace otel-demo, so the two services have backing addresses rather than missing endpoints.

The recurring chaos-mesh network partition applied to the shipping and quote pods (first application 00:46:18Z, ~55s per cycle, repeating each minute) blocked shipping's HTTP call to quote, producing the 5-second 'POST quote' timeouts, shipping '/get-quote' 500s, checkout PlaceOrder failures, frontend /api/checkout 500s and finally the frontend-proxy ingress 500s that the alert reports. The correlation in time (error onset right after 00:46Z) and the quote/shipping log bursts restricted to the experiment gaps support this, but the fault's declared parameters were not observable.

A second candidate that remains unresolved: the wrapped checkout error text says the failure was 'failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500', which points at the email service rather than quote. Email recorded no error-status spans and its throughput fell, while in the same trace shipping's own client span is named 'POST quote' and ends as 'Timeout'; which endpoint the message refers to, and whether email was also unreachable, could not be established.

Quote itself shows no failure of its own operations: its 'POST /getquote', 'calculate-quote' and '{closure}' span series carry STATUS_CODE_UNSET only (no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series returned for quote), so the quote service looks blocked/short of traffic rather than returning errors.

Pod crash, OOM or resource-driven restarts are not the cause: every otel-demo pod was Running/Ready with restartCount 0, shipping and quote containers had empty lastState, and the event grouping for the window contains no Pod events in namespace otel-demo (Pod reasons appear only for data-recorders).

An enabled flagd fault-injection flag is not the trigger: all flags in the flagd-config ConfigMap are in defaultVariant 'off' (false/0), so no ad/cart/payment/email/product-catalog/recommendation fault flag was in effect.

gaps: The NetworkChaos and Schedule objects could not be read (no readable kind for chaos-mesh custom resources in this Run), so the partition action, direction, target selectors, delay/loss parameters and declared duration are unverified; only their events were observed.

The event snapshot supplied covers 00:29:26Z-00:55:46Z only, so whether the experiments continued after 00:55:46Z is unverified even though error spans were still rising in the 10-minute window ending 01:01:24Z.

No change_history integration is available, so when and by whom the Schedule otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition was created or modified is unknown; the first Spawned event in the sampled events is 00:46:18Z.

The NetworkChaos name refers to 'email-checkout' while the Applied events name the shipping and quote pods, and the wrapped error message names the 'email service' while shipping's client span is 'POST quote' and reports Timeout; the exact endpoints of the partition and the meaning of that message are unresolved.

The RequestErrorRate alerting rule could not be retrieved (a rule_name=RequestErrorRate query returned no rule data), so its expression, threshold and the exact metric behind the reported 0.644 error rate are unknown.
Queries for NetworkPolicies and ResourceQuotas in otel-demo returned nothing, so their existence or content is unknown rather than proven absent.
next_steps: Inspect the chaos objects directly outside this Run: kubectl -n chaos-mesh get schedule otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition -o yaml and kubectl -n chaos-mesh get networkchaos -o yaml, to confirm action/direction/targets and whether the experiment is still active.

Confirm with the platform/chaos experiment owners whether a network partition between the shipping and quote pods (or between quote/shipping and email) is intentional during this window; suspend the Schedule if it is not.
After suspension, re-check shipping '/get-quote' and frontend-proxy 'ingress' error spans and quote 'Calculated quote' log rate to confirm recovery.
Retrieve the RequestErrorRate rule definition from the Prometheus rule files to confirm which metric and threshold the alert uses.
